instruction_basis: The wire instruction is the sealed 2026-08-25 DEV-1000 M0 instruction PLUS a pure suffix, and nothing else. M0's system message was rails.adapters.slurp._INSTRUCTION followed by 'Task contract:' and render_slurp_ontology(load_slurp_ontology(...)) -- rails.runner._agent_messages appended it; the whole 5,747-character string hashes to cef527896e9beef5774305e01dc29192fc2d5ca89fba5143e82f0b91a7cb86b8 on all 1,000 sealed MODEL_REQUEST records. This template reproduces that string byte-for-byte (its fixed half is _INSTRUCTION verbatim plus the same header; its {tool_schemas} fill re-renders the same ontology document) and appends 1,836 characters: the closed label inventory (data.slurp.render_slurp_label_inventory). Rendered instruction sha256 4073f79ef25c4796b0a46cb2ac7f5d4982c83084982b87ddd8a70504090d37db, 7,583 characters; added suffix sha256 46ee018e1bd2392c0e3654ddeacf4b7f32209da2a0c00cd7e658afe50ca0dda3. The flight script asserts the prefix relation before takeoff.
inventory_basis: What the sealed M0 prompt already had, and what it did not. It DID carry the closed list of 18 scenarios, the flat list of 46 actions, and the 55 entity type names (with up to 5 example fillers each). It did NOT carry the PAIRING: a reader of two independent lists sees 18 x 46 = 828 implied intents where only 60 (scenario, action) pairs occur in train. A model-free structural read of the 1,000 sealed M0 predictions measured the cost of that gap directly: 8.60 percent name a scenario outside the 18, 6.90 percent an action outside the 46, 0.28 percent of 718 entity mentions a type outside the 55 -- but 32.20 percent are a (scenario, action) pair that never occurs in train. The suffix this fragment adds is exactly that missing pairing plus the closed-choice constraint, which is also the element the only published prompt-only SLURP protocol uses (He & Garner arXiv:2305.13512 list the intents IN the prompt and report 79.25 intent accuracy for ChatGPT on oracle transcripts).
no_examples_basis: The added block carries label NAMES only: no example fillers, no exemplars, no retrieved evidence, no knowledge plane. It is the zero-shot direct baseline every mechanism must beat, not a few-shot or evidence-conditioned arm. The example fillers visible in the rendered instruction are the ones the sealed M0 contract already carried; removing them would have changed two things at once and confounded the contrast.
arm_basis: speech-feature-query, the SAME arm and the SAME audio path the sealed DEV-1000 M0 arm flew: mmproj-free decode over pre-materialized encoder packets from the registered promotion receipt, one input_speech_features query descriptor per contact, one contact per sample. policy 'fixed' routes core.flight.FlightRuntime to _run_speech_feature_direct / _dispatch_concurrent, which send exactly that message pair and add no phase, no second contact and no evidence.
scorer_basis: slurp-slu-official is the paper-facing scorer: the real, unmodified official evaluate.py at pinned commit 8eb16545762be97ace75334109d73824217311f1 in ~/.venvs/slurp-official-eval (used, never modified), --average micro, plus a numeric identity assertion against this study's own per-sample port. slurp-slu is the same registered function object under the name data.carriers gives SLURP's TaskLayout.official_scorer_id, declared so the manifest names the carrier's own scorer id as well. Both are run once over the complete manifest through core.scoring_batch, never sharded. The scorer refuses any row whose sample id names the held-out test split. NOTE for this @ts2 cell: the gold lookup must resolve through the @-suffix-stripping rail (data.variant_ids.published_sample_key, CLOSED 2026-09-07 per docs/readiness/2026-09-07-cross-carrier-silence-tail-v1-preregistration.md section 6.2) or every row fails closed at scoring.
what_this_is: configs/baseline/slurp-direct-closed-list.json for the cross-carrier silence-tail SLURP cell (SAEA-SLURP-DEV1000-CLOSED-LIST-TAIL2S-V1). FOUR keys differ and no others: the promotion receipt and its sha256 -- which have to be the @ts2 packet root's own, materialized by SAEA-SN-DEV1000-TS2-PREPROCESS-V1 -- and the two speech-feature identity ids, unique per cell so a trace never conflates this cell's audited payload identity with the sealed comparator's. The system message, the closed label inventory, the arm, the policy, and the scorers are byte for byte the sealed DEV-1000 closed-list arm's, so this cell's one-factor media contrast stays single-factor in exactly the media and nothing else.
